purpose: Measure the fixed direct property-ranking workflow on exactly the registered public candidate queries; do not change scientific predictions or select methods by timing.
candidate_calls: Cache identical full-solute-SMILES/full-solvent-SMILES/temperature triples within the supplied cohort. Report both candidate appearances and unique calls; all property methods use the identical policy.
feature_cache_policy: Clear loaded LightGBM query fingerprint and descriptor caches before every repetition without changing fitted medians. Recreate Chemprop graphs/loaders each repetition. Nearest-neighbor implementation rebuilds its indices per call. Library/OS caches are uncontrolled.
timing_scope: Report public request assembly, model loading, query featurization, forward computation and deterministic decision construction separately. Model-resident application time includes request assembly plus featurization/forward/decisions, excludes library import, checkpoint loading, provenance checks and output persistence. Model loading is a separate observed cost.
reference_check: Compare CPU values and decisions to saved validation property predictions without opening targets. Device/roundoff differences remain reported; never replace original scientific evaluations.
reporting: Amortized batch time per public question is throughput, not single-question interactive latency. CPU property costs and GPU LM costs must retain their device, batch, feature/cache and loading scopes. Shared-host contention is disclosed; no isolated-host or energy-cost claim. All methods and timing repetitions retained, including slower results.
